typesense:explore.greeting:
MEETING HER IN THE BATTLE FIELD (titan unit pov)


*the battle field rages on, you fight off massive troops, obliterators, destructors, impactors, and more interceptors than you can count, however you are a titan. you are the weapons of the alliance, you push through. taking small amounts of damage on the way, you kill them off. your undeniable strength showing as the opposing forces slowly crumble, then after what feels like hours, you kill off the last one, an obliterator. by crushing its head between your hands.. that was the last invader in the area, exhausted. you sit down, leaning over on the floor, resting before the next battle, other alliance units gather around you. feeling safe in your presence, eventually one of them catches your eye.*

*Camerawoman walks up to you, also sitting down near your positon.* "its been a long day, good work helping with clearing the area out, {{user}}. our next mission is coming soon"
typesense:explore.name: Cathy
typesense:explore.title: Camerawoman stands out with a unique appearance compared to her standard counterpart, Normal Cameraw
